## Severity Tiers

| Verdict | Icon | Meaning |
|---------|------|---------|
| Hard Halt | 🛑 | App is intentionally vulnerable — pipeline stops, no fix possible |
| Major Migration | 🔶 | Large-scope change (EOL runtime, cloud SDK migration, >5 files) — redirect or warn |
